svg.title: stellar-simulator
svg.desc: This is a generic Fe-like atom (56 u, ionization 7.9 eV, excitation 2.5 eV), not an identified observed transition. A single LTE absorbing screen uses F=exp(−τ); opacity scales with 10^[M/H] and Saha–Boltzmann populations. T is set equal to Teff. Electron density ne=10¹⁹ × 10^(log g−4.44) × 5772/T m⁻³ is an explicit schematic pressure proxy, not a calibrated atmosphere. Doppler b²=2kT/m+ξ²; the area-normalized opacity is broadened before transfer. Only instrumental broadening is a subsequent convolution. No line emission, damping, real atmosphere, NLTE or 3D prediction. Slider bounds define the teaching domain, not an interpolation grid. Sources: https://www.astro.uvic.ca/~tatum/stellatm/atm8.pdf https://www.astro.uvic.ca/~tatum/stellatm/atm11.pdf https://physics.nist.gov/cuu/Constants/Table/allascii.txt
